utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Eli — any carpool updates I should know about?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet, Ira — I’m waiting to hear if Tuesday still works. If it does, I’ll confirm with you by this evening.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll wait to hear from you by this evening.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the pickup time and where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll text you the pickup time and meet spot shortly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for your text.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the carpool is still on for tomorrow, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I want to double-check the timing and pickup order first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, please double-check it and let me know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the carpool. I’m happy to help out; just tell me the time and where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — I’ll check the pickup time and let you know where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for your message. Thanks, Cleo!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the pickup time and which kids are included in the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sorry, I’m blanking on the details right now—can you remind me which carpool you mean?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — I mean the school carpool for Tuesday mornings. If you don’t have the details handy, I can check and follow up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—did I miss the carpool details?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — you didn’t miss much. We’re just figuring out the pickup time and who’s riding with who.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — what pickup time are you leaning toward?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I was thinking around 7:30, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 7:30 works for me — I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the pickup spots—just tell me where everyone needs to be and what time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would help a lot—Mina needs to be at the school by 8:10, and Leo’s pickup is right after that at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — Mina at the school by 8:10, then Leo at the community center right after. I’ll keep those spots straight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool might be shifting a little this week—have you seen the latest update?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I haven’t seen the latest yet, but I can ask around and let you know. If it’s changing, I’ll spread the word fast.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Quinn — I’d appreciate that. If you hear anything, just let me know and I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, are we still on for carpool tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, still on for tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll repeat the carpool plan to everyone so we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll go by what you tell me, since I usually hear things second-hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll pass it along clearly, and if anything changes I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days and times are we planning for?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’m hoping for Monday and Wednesday mornings around 8, if that can work.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Monday and Wednesday mornings around 8 should work for me. I’ll help coordinate and confirm the final pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hi Eli — I heard the carpool’s still on, but I’m checking who’s driving and whether we need one extra seat.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, it’s still on. I can drive, and there’s room for one extra seat.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Eli — I’ll let everyone know you’re driving and there’s one extra seat.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m a bit late — what’s the carpool plan?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ll pick up Jo at 7:30, swing by your place at 7:40, and then we head out together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll be ready at 7:40.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the carpool—what time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you. I was thinking around 7:30, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 7:30 works for me. I can be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what time do you want to leave?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’d say let’s leave at 7:15 so we have a little cushion.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: 7:15 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I can help coordinate the carpool and keep everyone in the loop. What time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you confirm the pickup time and who’s in the carpool so I can double-check it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can confirm it once I hear the final pickup time and the list of riders — send me those, and I’ll make sure everyone’s included.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—carpool? Right, I’m here. What changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Nothing big yet—I just wanted to check we’re still on for the carpool and see if you need anything from me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, we’re still on—thanks for checking. I don’t need anything right now, but I might need a quick reminder on the time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Gus — I heard the carpool might be changing a bit. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Ira, I’ve just heard it might shift to a slightly earlier pickup. If you need, I can check with the others and see what’s settled.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus — that’d be great. Just let me know once it’s settled so I can plan my morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the carpool. What time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s aim for 7:30 AM if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 7:30 AM works for me — I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing and who’s picking everyone up—can we map out the stops so it stays on schedule?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — who needs the first pickup, and what time do you want everyone at the school?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s start with the closest house first, then mine, and aim to arrive at school 10 minutes early just in case.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m putting together the carpool and wanted to see if you want a spot. If you’re in, I can save you a seat.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes please, save me a seat — I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, I’ve got you down — I’ll save you a seat and send you the pickup details soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take the morning drop-off this week, but I’ll need to leave by 8:10 sharp for school pickup later. Does that still work for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, that still works great—thanks, Faye. I’ll handle the afternoon pickup and keep it on time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Oren — I appreciate you covering the afternoon pickup. I’ll text if anything changes on my end.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I can help coordinate the carpool—what days and times do you need covered?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still sorting out the schedule from the group, but I think we need Monday through Thursday mornings covered. I’ll send you the exact times as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, that works — send me the exact times when you have them, and I’ll get the carpool lined up for Monday through Thursday mornings.
